notes.title: The Wizards - Dark Times: Brotherhood Patch 1.28 is LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
We have released an exciting free update today, bringing a host of thrilling additions and enhancements to the game. Players can now experience the all-new Citadel of Aetheris, a stunning multiplayer map where strategy, teamwork, and powerful magic combine to create intense, action-packed battles.

[u][b]New Map: Citadel of Aetheris[/b][/u]
The new Citadel of Aetheris map offers a dynamic and challenging environment for players to test their magical prowess. This large multiplayer arena requires both strategic planning and teamwork to secure victory as players battle for dominance over the citadel using a variety of powerful spells and abilities. The Aetheris Citadel promises to become a key battleground for players seeking to conquer this magical stronghold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/a2b85194fbfc72cb273b88c9a44cbf04f3def039.png[/img]

[u][b]Other improvements[/b][/u]
In addition to the updates above, several other improvements have been made to enhance the overall gameplay experience. Spells have been rebalanced with changes to damage, range, and mechanics, making combat more strategic and exciting. Enemies have also been adjusted for greater challenge, with new health values and behavior changes. Other quality-of-life updates include a refreshed user interface, new class descriptions, improved menus, and faster progression with boosted XP rewards. Players can also toggle HP bars for enemies and enjoy new objectives in existing maps.

The full list of updates can be found below:

[b]New Map - “Citadel of Aetheris”[/b]
Re-balance of the multiplayer spells:
[*] Flame-thrower with increased damage, length(from 300 to 400) and radius of the spell.
[*] Fire-Lance switching hand position mechanic has been removed - for easier usage.
[*] Ice Sabers with increased damage(from 150 (Bash)/100(Throw) to 200(Bash)/125(Throw)).
[*] Icicle Projectiles with increased damage(from 50 to 85), faster loading (from 0.2s (per Icicle) to 0.12s), slightly slower flying speed (from 1500 to 1400).
[*]  Ice Nova with increased damage (from 10-50 to 30-90).
[*]  Chain Lightning with slightly decreased damage (from 50 to 45) and instead of jumping to 5 enemies now it'll jump to 4, smaller range (from 2000 to 1800).
[*]  Lightning Beam with increased damage (from 200 to 250).
[*] Lightning Hammer with increased damage (from 150 to 250), increased throwing speed and now is easier to catch due to a bigger catch threshold.
[*]  Rain of Arrows deals less damage on each class (from 5(dmg)x16(arrows) to 4x14).
New Sky lights in multiplayer maps.
Re-balance of the enemies:
[*] Fire Acolyte has more hp (from 550 to 800).
[*]  Fire type comes with greater strength dealing higher damage.
[*]  Ice types will have more endurance due to increased health points.
[*]  Lightning types will be more agile with their speed increased.
Now enemies also give more experience:
[*] Abigail from 300XP to 1000XP.
[*] Shroomlings from 6XP to 10XP.
[*]  Darklings from 10XP to 15XP.
[*] Grunts from 20XP to 30XP.
[*] Goblins from 10XP to 15XP.
[*]  Grunt Tanks from 40XP to 60XP.
[*]  Acolytes from 100XP to 150XP.
[*] ] Shamans from 75XP to  110XP.
[*] Shroomkings from 50XP to 125XP.
[*] Trolls from 125XP to 175XP.

[u][b]Additional Quality of Life enhancements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added HP bars which you can switch on and off in the options.
[*] New objective on the Castle map. A constant fight to capture a crystal.
[*] Crystal ball with tips has been improved and we added 6 new tips, haptics, updated UI.
[*] Added class descriptions near the class statues.
[*] Added timer for Training Room bow mini-game.
[*] UI for the spell choosing has been improved f.ex haptics added, new electric icons.
[*] Updated Main Menu/Pause Menu - added haptics, refreshed color scheme, updated UI-tips, organized menu.
[*] Challenge board UI has been improved and is more readable.
[*] Added haptics in class-choosing altars.
[*] Added Icons with player’s levels per profile in the multiplayer menu.
[*] Added player’s current level in the pause menu.
[*] Overall UI, text, and pop-up's have been improved to be more appealing and to be more organized.
[*] Now players will get a pop-up which informs about other players waiting for you to join the battle.
[*] Collision/combat fixes on different maps.
[*] Added missing translations.
[*] Multiplayer HUB Quality of Life changes. Correcting collisions, changing height of some interactable objects.
[*] Crystals in Abigail fight should be easier to hit with spells.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.26 Now Live: Cross-play is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1]🔮✨ Hello Wizards! ✨🔮[/h1]

As promised, we're excited to bring you the new June update! We’re introducing some fantastic new features, including the addition of adaptive trigger mechanics for magic bows in Primeweald Trials (our new name for the Coop mode) on PS VR2 and the much-anticipated [b]global CROSS-PLAY feature[/b], allowing PC VR, PS VR2, and Meta Quest wizards to join forces! Take a look at the changes below:

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added adaptive trigger mechanics to magic bows in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode) to the PS VR2
[*] Added a global [b]cross-play [/b]feature between PC VR, PS VR2 and Meta Quest players
[*] Added improved global mechanics to control spatial sounds in the land of Primeweald
[*] Improving the volume balance of spells, especially the explosion of the magic shield in Primeweald Trials
[*] All spells in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode) received a sound upgrade
[*] Increased spell resistance of magic shields for all wizard classes in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode)
[*] Reduced teleportation rod regeneration time from 3 seconds to 1.5 seconds. This makes gameplay smoother and more fun to tactically move around arenas in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode)
[*] Fixed the error related to displaying the incorrect name from HUB to Citadel in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode)
[*] Fixed the error related to displaying the incorrect name from achievements to challenge in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode). Now players will not be confused reaching new challenges
[*] Rebuilded the entire Citadel after the goblin army attack
[*] Reworked the main menu and profile selector
[*] Adjusted and fixed the pendulums in the Enchanted Forest in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode)
[*] Redesigned the In-Game Menu and Summary Menu to display better for players, improving user comfort
[*] The Citadel received optimized dynamic candles for PC VR and PS VR2. Now players can extinguish them with a push and light them with a fireball
[*] Fixed the replication of the Darkling Bomb, which sometimes didn't explode
[*] Added an icon and color code to indicate unlocked new spells
[*] Optimized graphics and improved performance in Campaign and in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode)
[*] Optimized most of the opponents, now spawns should be smoother than ever
[*] Fixed the problem with the Korean and Japanese translations in the boss fight level in the campaign
[*] Created an additional tutorial explaining the resistance of elemental enemies in the Prologue in the campaign
[*] Added a widget with information about the level of the player with whom you are fighting together against Abigail's minions
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/c639f565c1fe69b7eae5ea05286f180f30886b7b.png[/img]
That’s it! This patch concludes the roadmap and we would like to thank you for your support and patience throughout these past 3 months. We hope it was worth the wait and that you will keep on having fun in Meliora just as we enjoy delivering you more wizardly content! Stay tuned for more news in the very near future!


🔮✨ Thank you Wizards! ✨🔮

notes.title: Patch 1.25 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]🔮✨ Hello Wizards! ✨🔮[/h1]

We hope you're all flourishing in your magical endeavors! We're thrilled to announce the rollout of our latest update, brimming with fixes and fresh content to enhance your mystical adventures. The roadmap is right on track, with one minor adjustment: the Meta Quest Crossplay feature will now debut in May. The crossplay is nearly working as it should be, but this shift ensures that when it arrives, it'll offer you the most enchanting experience possible. Thank you very much for your understanding on this one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/1cc827c4d0390e9470d7a27677a0c7a377e22b96.png[/img]

Now, onto the exciting additions in this patch! Prepare to encounter a formidable new adversary in Multiplayer – the enigmatic [b]Shroom King[/b]! And that's not all! We've spruced up the graphics, fine-tuned performance, and even added more excitement with additional exploding vases in Multiplayer levels.

Patch 1.25 - PC VR / PC VR Rift
[list]
[*] Added a new enemy in Multiplayer - Shroom King
[*] Optimized graphics and improving performance in Singleplayer and coop modes
[*] Optimized the number of game setting saves, now the game should load a little faster
[*] Fixed the bug of detecting index controllers playing on Vive Cosmos series goggles
[*] Changed the way of launching music tracks in multiplayer mode, now more often other tracks fire during combat
[*] Fixed the way the name of the player playing on the Rift goggles is displayed
[*] Added more exploding vases on multiplayer levels
[*] Fixed a problem with the Darkling bomb sound not firing sometimes
[*] Disabled friendly fire from darkling bombs, now darklings don't kill each other
[*] Fixed the problem with the sound not firing in the UI in multiplayer mode
[*] Global increase in texture resolutions and improving the settings of displayed triangles in some meshes
[*] Fixed an issue with player speed settings not saving correctly in Singleplayer mode. Now settings from singleplayer mode do not affect settings in multiplayer mode
[*] Added the possibility for clients to approve and confirm decisions, now the clients entering the portal can approve/confirm the game and start it
[*] Added the possibility for clients to approve the return to HUB
[*] Fixed bug with indicator displayed in multiplayer mode under pause menu disable, now indicator does not display after exiting pause menu
[*] Added burnable flags in multiplayer mode
[*] Improved damage mechanics of Meteor Lance spell, now deals damage once instead of multiple times
[*] Added an option in Multiplayer to disable above the player's name, especially can be useful when recording footage

[*] Added an additional UI with the player's name above the challenge board in Multiplayer
[*] Added signs above the main exits to improve player navigation through the rooms in Multiplayer
[*] Added gold color to player names in displayed messages when a player joins the Multiplayer game
[*] Improved “small” tutorials in Multiplayer with displayed hand spirits showing how to enchant spells, now they are more dynamic and optimized
[*] All Enemies in Multiplayer have their lives reduced by 15% and each player receives 15% more life

notes.title: Patch 1.23 Now Live & Roadmap Reveal!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Fellow Wizards! 🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for the incredible support since the launch of our game back in December! We've been hard at work, and we're thrilled to finally bring you some exciting updates! As always, your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping the direction of our development, and we're eager to share with you what we've been working on. 

Right, let's dive into the Patch Notes. Oh, and these are all applicable to [b]PCVR[/b] and [b]PSVR2[/b]:

[h2]Patch 1.23 - Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[b]CROSSPLAY[/b] - crossplay should now work between PCVR and PSVR2! Play together with your console friends!
[b]General[/b] - added better settings for foliage scalability. More foliage is displayed on the High setting.
[b]General[/b] - global increase in texture resolutions.
[b]General[/b] - improved lighting and shadows on all maps.
[b]General[/b] - fixed problems with possible issues at the Tutorial Level.
[b]Campaign[/b] - fixed and balanced the following achievements: Lightbearer, Scholar, Got the Spotlight, Necessary Violence, The Shroomlings Too?!, Ascendant, Dry Foot.

[b]Campaign[/b] - fixed collisions and enhanced visuals in Necropolis.
[b]Campaign[/b] - fixed Chinese localization issue.
[b]Coop[/b] - fixed small issues with combat music.
[b]Coop[/b] - fixed a potential bug with an invisible Abigail boss fight.
[b]Coop[/b] - fixed issues with lighting and streaming graphic details on the Enchanted Forest.
[b]Coop[/b] - fixed the progression system when a player dies during the game and joins back under the right conditions.
[b]Coop[/b] - added missing sounds in the Matchmaking UI.
[b]Coop[/b] - disabled easy, normal, hard game mode settings. Normal mode is now the default.

notes.title: Behold - Patch 1.21
notes.notes:
[h2]Good day to you, Wizards! 🖐️ [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Even though the holidays are around the corner and 2023 is inevitably coming to an end, [b]we are not slowing down![/b] 🤓 In your reviews, discussions, and opinions, you've pointed out that there are a few gameplay elements that need minor tweaks and fixes, and we are always happy to listen to your feedback and respond to it.

And so, here it is! [b]Patch 1.21[/b] is the first Patch for the Brotherhood update, but you can be sure that there are many more to come! Of course, our work on the major update improving the game's visuals, which we announced a few days ago, is in full swing, and we are also working on important fixes to solve problems with Index Controllers and Virtual Desktop... but for now, let us get back to the point.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/a3634481e1e24a4d4ce3dc60c5da7c93847526cf.png[/img]


We're sure you're curious about what's new in [b]Patch 1.21[/b], so without further ado, let's take a look at the patch notes, shall we? 👀


[h2]Patch 1.12 - Patch Notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Coop[/b] - Adjustments in the EXP points gained from opponents - Shroomlings and Abigail have been adjusted to provide more experience points.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Fixed issues with Meteor spell replication on the client side.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Resolved an issue with disappearing game state saves when switching between Singleplayer and Multiplayer Modes.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Improved voice line activation for Abigail and Aurelius.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Overhauled Mandrake mechanics in the Dark Woods level to make it more challenging for players to find Mandrakes. Players now need to search for active Mandrakes that call out with their cries.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Balanced combat on Foggy Passage, Forest, and Dark Woods levels. Enemies spawn farther from players.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Reduced the range of the indicator in the magical skill tree book. The distance is now shorter, preventing players from selecting skills while standing far from the game session activation point.
[*] [b]Coop[/b] - Added a ground destruction effect when Abigail hits the ground during a boss fight.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Fixed the Bow mechanics to prevent an extra arrow from appearing on the bow.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Resolved an issue with player health points when transitioning from Singleplayer Hardcore Mode to Multiplayer Mode.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Introduced a new texture for the portal effect where players confirm game sessions.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Fixed paths in doors in the Foggy Passage level to prevent enemies from getting stuck in them.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Increased the title captions on information boards by 15%.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Enhanced Shaman balance; they will now more frequently provide buffs that increase scale and enemy health.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Improved the tracking of challenges related to completing levels in co-op.
[*] [b]Single Player[/b] - Improved gameplay in the boss fight level; players will no longer get stuck during rapid teleportation.
[*] [b]Single Player[/b] - Improved gameplay in the Necropolis level to prevent player blockage during game backtracking.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b] - Improved functions related to rendering decals on the shield and weapon of Tank Grunt.
[*] [b]General[/b] - Fixing issues with displaying translations in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean languages in Multiplayer Mode.
[/list]

As usual, we would appreciate hearing [b]your feedback[/b] on the mentioned changes and any suggestions for additional improvements that could be incorporated into the Brotherhood update 🧐 For this purpose, you can use our Social Media channels, Discord server and Steam Discussions. [b]Thank you![/b]

notes.title: The Visuals Upgrade Patch is on its way 🎨
notes.notes:
[h2]Good day to you, Wizards! 🖐️ [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It's been almost [b]two weeks[/b] since the release of the Brotherhood update. During this time, we've gathered a wealth of valuable feedback from you all, encompassing both the positive and the problematic aspects of the game. However, [b]one issue stands out[/b] 👀 more than others and unquestionably warrants individual attention and extensive response.

Your reports on Steam Discussions and our Discord server ([b]for which we are very grateful![/b]) highlighted that the PCVR version of the Brotherhood update doesn't achieve the expected visual quality. And there is no doubt that you are right! We managed to identify the problem you showed us in your reports, and we want to sincerely apologize that it may negatively impact your [b]The Wizards - Dark Times: Brotherhood experience[/b]. Indeed, exactly as you described, the visuals of the game took a hit after the update release.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/48e5e0f3db3c8f8236857305baf21db53e5f7ab7.png[/img]


[h2]The Visual Upgrade Patch is coming soon 🧐[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
With that said, we'd like to announce that we've initiated the development of a [b]patch aimed at enhancing the game's visuals[/b] 🛠 While there is undoubtedly a substantial amount of work ahead, we will make every effort to implement it as soon as possible, ensuring no player feels deceived or dissatisfied. Our team is now prioritizing the issue concerning visual quality and will exert every effort to upgrade it to [b]meet your expectations[/b] once again.

While we address the necessary fixes, we encourage you to keep the conversation going and share the tales of your awesome [b]adventures in the magical world of Meliora[/b] 🧙‍♂ Please remember that we are always open to your feedback, suggestions and opinions, so keep them coming, okay? Thank you for staying with us, Wizards!

Once again - [b]sincere apologies[/b] for the inconvenience, everyone. More info on the new Patch coming soon!

notes.title: Developer Announcement: Brotherhood Update rescheduled to Nov 28th
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Wizards!  🧙‍♂️ 🖐️ [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We wish we had better news for you today, everyone... There is no easy way to say it, so we will just go straight up. We are sorry, everyone, but in pursuit of an even more enchanting and magical experience, we have decided to [u][b]reschedule the Brotherhood Update release to Nov 28, 2023[/b][/u]


[h2]Even better quality and undisturbed gameplay [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We are sure that you are wondering what are the reasons for this unexpected situation, and we will do our best to [b]answer all your questions.[/b] Making a long story short, it turned out that our game still requires a few final tweaks and refinements. What does it mean? 🧐

We're currently [b]improving the game's optimization[/b] that will make our game run smooth on both minimal and recommended specs, unfortunately, we just need a little bit more time to iron out this area of development 🛠️ We believe that a game as dynamic and action-packed as The Wizards - Dark Times should be [b]completely smooth[/b] and provide uninterrupted, satisfying fun for all our players.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/522da5108f7cc886dd699f912bdaa0265efbe1ea.png[/img]


Rest assured, that we know how much you are waiting for the Brotherhood update and how enthusiastically you are counting down the days until its debut on [b]PCVR and Quest Store[/b]. Just like you, we can't wait to jump deep into the wild Brotherhood action and burn, freeze or shock anything that gets in our way. This time will come really soon…


[h2]20 days more [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Now, only 20 days [/b] ⏳  left until the release of the Brotherhood update. In light of this delay, we remain hopeful that you can still find a reserve of enthusiasm and understanding for our decision. As always - thank you for your continued support and remember - the new magical journey begins on Nov 28!  🤩 

Thank you for always standing with us, Wizards! And see you soon! 🌟🔮🌟

notes.notes:
Our goal for this update is to give you a spellbinding experience with friends, and for you to enjoy the epic new features and gameplay to the max in Meliora. It is for that reason we’ve decided we need a little more time to polish the update for you.


[b][h3]The Brotherhood Update will now launch November 9th 2023 🧙‍♂[/h3][/b]
[hr][/hr]
As many of you wizards know, throughout September we ran an open beta for our newly remastered The Wizards - Dark Times, especially the all new Brotherhood co-op gameplay. We had an absolute blast with you and were given a lot of great feedback. Some of that feedback we’d like to spend more time with, especially that which ensures a more seamless crossplay at launch for PC VR and Quest players. 

We wish we could have hit this update on time, and are disappointed we can’t deliver, but at the same time we know our community (yep! that's you!) and know that you’d prefer waiting a little longer for the better gaming experience.

notes.title: Brotherhood Update - Enemies Overview
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Greetings, Wizards! 🖐[/b][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We don't know about you guys, but [b]we just LOVE[/b] all kinds of bestiaries, lorebooks, and guides 📚 Discovering long-forgotten secrets, viewing astonishing sketches, learning about the habits of mysterious beings, and of course[b] planning a strategy to defeat them[/b] are things every true adventurer dreams of! That is why we felt that such a rich and vast world as Meliora deserves its own unique tale. This tale may be quite [b]scary[/b]... yet very, very [b]interesting[/b]! 

Ok, are you brave enough to face the [b]hordes of hostile, magical creatures?[/b] Sure you are! After all, you are a wizard, right? Thanks to the bestiary below, you will learn how to fight against extremely dangerous foes. Be vigilant and soon you will discover their [b]strengths and weaknesses[/b], the way they fight, think, and move around the battlefield. Such knowledge can save your and your companions' lives, so take a deep breath, blow the dust off the ancient pages, and get right to it! 😗💨📜

[h2]Grunts[/h2]
Grunts are [b]the very core[/b] of the cruel forces you will face while playing the "Brotherhood" update. You can be sure you will encounter them on every single map, so you'd better be prepared... which won't be easy, as Grunts come in [b]many different kinds and forms[/b]. And it is not just about the elements variants (Basic, Fire, Frost, and Storm) but also their varied weapons and specializations! 🏹

Grunt is a [b]very versatile unit[/b]. It can attack you from a distance with its deadly bow or engage into the melee combat with use of a shield and sword. Each of them will effectively occupy your attention and force you to attack, protect yourself, or change your position. You certainly don't want to overlook the Shield Grunt, which protects itself with... well, a large shield. If you don't attack it from behind, it will soon get close to you and crush you with a deadly charge. Ouch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/a085c7762d0193d74ceca690b1278543fec0971b.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Goblins[/h2]
Goblins may not be very big or strong, as their tactics are based on completely different traits. When you see a single Goblin, you can ignore it and focus on more dangerous opponents. Make no rookie mistake though and keep an eye on the upcoming Goblins - they will try to [b]swarm you with their great numbers[/b], and if you don't get rid of them quickly enough, you'll soon be in big trouble! 😬 Their little sharp daggers can do a lot of damage - especially when they stab their encircled victim from all directions.

As if that was not enough, in addition to the basic version, Goblins can also use the powers of Fire, Frost, and Storm. They are a small target, but most often one hit is enough to slay them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/878f936656f5dba0a019d2cd3f09632f3e3cc32a.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Darklings[/h2]
Ugh... these guys are annoying, you can take our word for that! Unlike Goblins, Darklings will try to keep their distance and [b]shower you with their deadly bombs[/b] 💣 When you start chasing them, they will simply run away in search of a better spot. Depending on their type - Basic, Fire, Frost, or Storm - they will use different kinds of bombs. They can do a lot of damage to you and your team, so be careful!

Fortunately, Darklings also have a few weaknesses. They're not very strong, so they can't throw their projectiles too far - one of the best ways to defeat them is to outreach them and get rid of them from afar. In addition, they are [b]not very durable units[/b]... unless we're talking about a Darkling Captain or Darkling Champion! They are significantly better armored than their subordinates and are able to throw much bigger, more dangerous explosives. Bombs away!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/d82f1dc3bbd558b280f03296c922955b4bab0187.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Shroomlings[/h2]
They may look somewhat cute, but they're extremely dangerous. When a Shroomling finds itself near the careless victim, it rushes toward them and... explodes! 🍄💥 This heroic suicide blast doesn't just hurt the target, but it also leaves a menacing thick cloud. Due to its rounded shapes and short legs, [b]Shroomling is rather slow[/b], which leaves us some time to react - you can either escape or destroy it from a safe distance.

But there is more... among the Shroomling tribes you can sometimes meet a champion! Champion Shroomling is much more poisonous than its minor brethren - it will leave a deadly smoke everywhere it goes and occasionaly release a [b]large cloud of spores![/b] Champions are known for their slowness and high damage resistance. All types of Shroomlings come in numerous elemental variants.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/af016e6f0250062f60e3bfbd84322b39c8d1b9ad.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Shamans[/h2]
In addition to throwing dangerous projectiles at players, its main task is to [b]buff and heal nearby units.[/b] Shamans can increase their allies’ health pool, provide elemental resistance, or place a totem to heal them. Hitting the Shaman will be a real trick as it can teleport across the battlefield. Even so, [b]destroying them as your priority target[/b] will always be a good idea - buffed units can prove to be much more formidable and difficult to defeat... not to mention that Shamans will heal them and thwarted your efforts to hurt them! ☠️

The shaman comes in the Basic, Fire, Frost, and Storm form.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/aed1f8cd3503c92c08779d3c55c0b9f2b0b0df84.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Witches and Acolytes[/h2]
Acolytes are the [b]masters of elemental magic[/b]. Each of them specializes in a different field - 
Fire Acolytes are known for their ability to inflict tremendous damage. Frost Acolytes use defensive magic and are very versatile. Storm Acolytes applies area damage and make Wizards to constantly change their positions. A challenge worthy of a true mage, so get ready for a demanding spellcasting duel! 🔥❄️⚡️ 

However, among your enemies, there is only one who has mastered the art of magic to perfection... Witches not only can use the vide range of spells (including dark Umbral spells), but also [b]create their own copies[/b] to confuse you and shower you with a magic projectiles. Defeating the witch is quite a challenge and it is best to attack her as a whole team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/757962446aa86d13bd13d8ed8c96c40b96b3e2ed.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Trolls and Battle Trolls[/h2]
When you hear his [b]heavy footsteps[/b] or see his gigantic body - be careful! This mighty beast will tirelessly [b]chase you[/b] and try to crush you, no matter what. The troll is a very resilient opponent and it will take many deadly spells to knock it down. Its secret weapon is the ability to throw huge boulders - being hit by such a missile could prove tragic! 😵

Battle Troll is a better armored and equipped version of this enormous giant. It may be a bit slower than the base type, but it makes up for it with its [b]exceptional durability[/b]. One hit of a Battle Troll can end the life of a careless Wizard, so make sure you always keep your distance from its huge, deadly mace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/f521f8d8c092abdfef04c37beeeccf592831ed48.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Now you are prepared![/h3]
We hope that our bestiary will come in handy, when the time comes. [b]Hostile creatures of Meliora[/b] will do whatever they can to make it harder for you to complete the mission and advance to the next map. Fortunately, now you know what to expect from them and how to survive their wrath. [b]Well... at least in theory.[/b] 😁

With the help of [b]your fellow wizards[/b] you will surely develop lots of interesting tactics and ways to defeat your opponents! If luck is on your side, you will reach the Boss map... and believe us - things don't get easier around there! [b]Ok, that's it for today[/b] - thank you and see you next time, mages!

notes.title: Discover the Brotherhood Update game modes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Greetings, Wizards! 🖐[/b][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The first Brotherhood Closed Beta is behind us, so it's a good time to thank our awesome testers and the whole The Wizards - Dark Times community! Thanks to [b]your overwhelming enthusiasm[/b], commitment, and absolutely great feedback we learned a lot about our game and found out how we can make it even better. We were delighted to discover that [b]100%[/b] of the testers surveyed would recommend the game to their friends based on their Beta experience. [b]Thank you, everyone[/b]! 🙏

However, today we want to tell you about something else. As you all surely know, the main axis of the Brotherhood update is [b]beating so-called maps[/b] 🗺️ Each of them is full of interesting elements, epic visuals, vicious enemies, and... [b]diversified objectives![/b] You and your friends will have to complete various tasks in order to beat a given map and move on to the next one. But how do you do that?


[h2]What challenges await you and your friends?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Quick spellcasting, smart movement, and high accuracy are sometimes not enough! Yes, they are important, but still, if you don't [b]complete the map objectives[/b], your opponents will soon outnumber and overcome you! We don't want that to happen, do we?

As you progress through the game, you have to remember that each map has different goals... yet all of them have something in common. In order to open the portal leading to the next level, you must first complete the specific map objectives. Simple as that... or is it? We can't wait to see if your mage-squads can cope with the challenges we have prepared for you! Ok, are you ready to get to know [b]some of the objectives?[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/5c1145e98cf71f14ca225f489d538e44c90980a8.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[b]Collect and deliver[/b] - one of the challenges you will have to face will be finding the characteristic items and delivering them to the right place. Of course, your opponents will do their best to prevent you from completing this task! An example? Sure 😁 During your adventure in the Dark Woods you will have to find glowing mandrakes and throw them into huge cauldrons full of green, glowing goo! How fun!

[b]Seek and destroy[/b] - this kind of challenge is somewhat different in its assumptions. This time your mission will be to find the key elements of the map and destroy them. Easy to say, hard to do, as they are protected by hordes of powerful foes. Is it better to stick together? Or maybe split up in search of these unusual objects? It all depends on you!

[b]Get through[/b] - things are about to get messy. This mode will put your spellcasting skills to the difficult test. The goal here is simple and fun - to emerge victorious you will have to break through a narrow chokepoint. You need to have eyes all around your head, because the enemies will attack you from behind and from the front. Freeze, incinerate, or shock them and remember about the only rule - always move forward! 👣

[b]Survive[/b] - Can you and your team fight off the murderous attacks from successive waves of enemies? Can you cooperate, protect each other from harm, and get rid of numerous foes? Well... we will see. This is a very dynamic, highly combat-focused mode. Your survival will depend on your and your friends' spellcasting skills... and hey, make sure to resurrect them when they fall!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/295ee46e0b015493da6eec8111372ed9132a6202.gif[/img]


[h2]Test new tactics, mage classes, and spells![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Of course, these are [b]not all[/b] variants of the game modes and maps - you will have to discover the rest of them for yourselves! Not to mention the boss fight zones... which is a tale for another day. 

One way or another, [b]adaptation is the key to victory[/b]. Be sure to check out all of the combinations, character development paths, and playstyles. The abilities of different Wizards complement each other perfectly and fill different niches. We believe that you and your friends will quickly discover your own way to victory 🤝 Only smart, efficient cooperation will allow you to understand and execute all the objectives... and that is something that even the most powerful magician in the world cannot do alone.

notes.title: Hardcore Mode/Adventure Mode Hotfix
notes.notes:
Greetings Wizards,

We recently discovered our newest patch has altered some of your saved game files. We have reverted all saved games to Adventure Mode.

If you want to switch back to Hardcore Mode, [b]please update the game and follow the instructions below:[/b]

1. Start the game and select your profile
2. Press the button combination:

[i]CTRL+ALT+H[/i] to switch from Adventure Mode to Hardcore Mode
[i]CTRL+ALT+A[/i] to switch from Hardcore Mode to Adventure Mode

[b]You should hear a sound confirming the change.[/b]

3. Press "Continue from Hub" or "Continue from Checkpoint"
[b]4. Once the game is loaded, leave to the Main Menu again[/b]
5. Select your profile again - game mode should be switched and updated according to your choice.

Big thanks to [i]C4ET4uK[/i] for reporting this issue. While we don't always respond immediately, we read all your posts! 
If you ever run into trouble with the game, please share the feedback either on the Steam forum or on our Discord. Our goal is always your satisfaction.
